decision_estimand: Top-5 regional survey-zone decision under a fixed training-only candidate pool and a 10-km held-out recovery endpoint

selection.tie_break: descending local score, then stable candidate/site ID
selection.score_interpretation: occurrence-conditioned local environmental support; not occupancy probability or calibrated habitat suitability

2026-07-24_reconstruction.note: secondary reconstruction; local-only equaled frozen plant ACSP and was close to frozen animal ACSP

2026-08-08_former_untouched_now_developm.note: these outcomes were inspected during v2 development and are not independent confirmation for the practical core

negative_development.decision: do not promote learned/router/complementarity v2 variants; retain the simpler local-only rule

untouched_confirmation.primary_same_pool_comparator: official spsurvey::grts proportional to local evidence with requested 10-km minimum distance
untouched_confirmation.inference: pair bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0 and sign-flip p < 0.05; negative/equivalent results retained; no retuning
untouched_confirmation.broad_tool_claim_requires: separate predeclared end-to-end biosurvey comparison using native region+raster site generation

claim_boundary.allowed_before_confirmation: local-only is the parsimonious practical-core candidate selected after development; it is not yet validated as superior to established survey-design tools
claim_boundary.not_allowed_before_confirmation: ACSP Practical Core is superior to GRTS, biosurvey, SDM, or existing survey-planning tools
